comment: NRPS-like oxidoreductase with carboxylic acid reductase activity.

reactions.description: Reduces ilicicolinic acid B in the ascochlorin/ascofuranone biosynthetic pathway.
Reduction of the carboxylic acid to an aldehyde, converting ilicicolinic acid B to ilicicolin B.
